name: 2026 KC3
verdict_text: Clearly seen in SPHEREx photos 38 days before anyone found it.

story.plain: A near-Earth asteroid about the size of a few city blocks. It was first reported in May 2026. In this sample, SPHEREx had already photographed it weeks earlier, while nobody was looking for it.

cloud.note: Sample: clones drawn from made-up uncertainties around the real orbit. after = with the Rewind positions added; null if nothing measured.

quiz.answer_text: Yes. The dot in the middle is the asteroid, exactly where its orbit says it should be.
